ixu-page-1.webp.zh: 奥兰加巴德机场航站楼外景：白色弧顶下是落客车道与出发层入口。
ixu-page-1.webp.en: The terminal forecourt — a white barrel-vaulted roof over the drop-off lane and departures entrance.

ixu-page-2.webp.zh: 从草坪望向航站楼：弧形屋面沿立面展开，塔台在右侧远处。
ixu-page-2.webp.en: The terminal from the lawn — the curved roof running along the frontage, with the control tower far to the right.

ixu-page-3.webp.zh: 出发层入口：雨棚上写着「WELCOME TO CHHATRAPATI SAMBHAJINAGAR AIRPORT」与「प्रस्थान DEPARTURE」。
ixu-page-3.webp.en: The departures entrance — the canopy lettered 'WELCOME TO CHHATRAPATI SAMBHAJINAGAR AIRPORT' and 'प्रस्थान DEPARTURE'.

ixu-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 航站楼前的蓝色标示写着机场英文名，右侧一块牌子上标着「到达」，门前一排绿植。
ixu-chatgpt-01.webp.en: Blue signs on the terminal read 'Aurangabad Airport' and 'Arrival', with a row of potted plants along the kerb.

ixu-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 一架靛蓝航空客机在跑道上滑行，围墙外是连片城区屋顶，近处地上摊着一片亮黄色的东西。
ixu-chatgpt-02.webp.en: An IndiGo jet rolls along the runway beyond a low boundary wall, town rooftops behind and a bright yellow patch on the ground in front.

ixu-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 旅客们提着行李穿过机坪，走向远处那道长长的弧形金属屋面航站楼。
ixu-chatgpt-03.webp.en: Passengers walk out across the apron toward the long curved metal roof of the terminal in the low sun.

ixu-chatgpt-04.webp.zh: 一架大型双发客机开着着陆灯正对镜头，灰白的雾霭里能看见左侧的格子塔架。
ixu-chatgpt-04.webp.en: A large twin-jet faces the camera with its landing lights on, a stack of lattice towers hazy at the left edge.

ixu-chatgpt-05.webp.zh: 蓝色「出发」指示牌挂在钢桁架雨棚下，行李车排成一列，两名安保人员正往里走。
ixu-chatgpt-05.webp.en: A blue 'Departure' sign hangs beneath the steel-truss canopy, luggage trolleys lined up as two security staff walk in.

ixu-chatgpt-06.webp.zh: 夜色里航站楼顶的机场名牌亮着白光，车灯扫过路障与成排的盆栽。
ixu-chatgpt-06.webp.en: At night the airport's name glows white above the entrance while headlights sweep across barriers and rows of potted plants.

ixu-chatgpt-07.webp.zh: 阴雨雾霾中，一架尾翼朱红的客机正对镜头滑行，前方是枯黄的灌木与草地。
ixu-chatgpt-07.webp.en: A red-tailed jet rolls head-on down the runway through drizzle, dry scrub and grass filling the foreground.
